concerns.evidence: native_capsule includes json_new and load_frozen in its pure set. Independent spies observed json_new reaching Path.open(mode=x) and load_frozen reaching importlib.util.spec_from_file_location while execution_enabled=false. Spies raised before any write or import. The CLI --execute and all 15 non-pure capsule functions still reject before native side effects.
concerns.implication: The callable capsule is an implementation container, not a complete side-effect authorization boundary. Documentation saying all native side-effect functions are guarded overstates this boundary.
concerns.required_for_activation: Expose only stage-authorized operations in the executable dispatcher, or guard writer/importer access as well. Do not treat native_capsule return value as a permit or independently executable admission.
concerns.title: Capsule internal writer and module loader are not protected by inactive execution policy

concerns.evidence: Three handmade dictionaries were accepted despite pure_reference_train>MLM_train, pure_reference_val>MLM_val, or query_full_paths_scored>unique_full_paths-pure_reference_train-pure_reference_val. The existing validator correctly rejects below4096, aggregate overflow, boolean/noninteger counts, and pair-cost overflow.
concerns.implication: corpus_budget is arithmetic on caller-provided counts and cannot itself certify coherent actual corpus membership or fit-update admission.
concerns.required_for_activation: Derive all counts from the same sealed actual full-path corpus/split/roster/query joins. Require per-split pure counts<=corresponding MLM counts and scored-query count<=remaining nonreference unique paths, plus exact membership checks, before budget admission.
concerns.title: Corpus budget validator accepts impossible split and query cardinalities
